scope: Source with non-secret instance/path/time-window and invocation matching constants, plus synthetic tests; no actual logs, API results or credentials.
dependencies: Existing official Aliyun CLI 3.5.1 and external configured profile for separately authorized controller use
restorationLimits: Preserve source layout and review fixed matching constants before future use.
eventTags are lexical matches, not task terminal states.
Absence of log evidence does not prove absence of submission or execution.
Query only the saved original InvokeId; UNKNOWN is not permission to resubmit.
Intent, actual response, profile and runtime state are excluded; this source snapshot is not an execution grant.
Time/byte thresholds are soft checks; text-derived exitCode is not an authoritative API terminal status.
The source sets a 60-second API command timeout and a separate 75-second CLI communication timeout.
Query JSON fallback is specific to the reviewed diagnostic script and is not a general-purpose log sanitizer.
verificationScope: Static hashes and Python grammar/embedding checks plus exact remote Git/content verification; no project source or test execution.
